landing.headline: Private chat, no phone number needed
landing.sub: Find friends by username and chat in realtime. Sign in with Google, or try it right away as a guest.
landing.bubble4: Yep. Pick a username and go.
landing.s1d: Use your Google account, or start as a guest in one click.
landing.s2d: Choose a unique username and display name so friends can find you.
landing.s3d: Search a username and send your first message instantly.
landing.featTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't
landing.fd1: No phone number or contact list. Share only your username.
landing.fd2: Messages arrive instantly over a live connection.
landing.fd3: See when your message is sent and when it's read.
landing.fd4: Know when the other person is replying.
landing.fd5: Follows your system theme, or pick one yourself.
landing.trustSub: pmess is a simple project. Here's exactly how your data is handled.
landing.tr1: Not end-to-end encrypted. Server administrators can read messages.
landing.tr2: Conversations are deleted after 1 month of inactivity.
landing.tr3: Guest accounts are deleted 30 minutes after their last message.
landing.a1: Yes. Sign in with Google or continue as a guest at no cost.
landing.a2: Guests get a temporary account to chat right away. It is deleted automatically, so sign in with Google if you want to keep your chats.
landing.a3: Yes. Open Settings and delete your account at any time.
landing.a4: Not end-to-end. Don't share sensitive information over pmess.
landing.ctaSub: It takes less than a minute to get started.

onboarding.title: Choose a username
onboarding.hint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscore.
onboarding.heading: Set up your profile

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: No conversations yet. Search for a username to start chatting.
chat.contactTitle: How can the developer reach you?
chat.contactHint: Optional. Your answer is sent as a normal message and is deleted with your guest account.
chat.sendFailed: Message could not be sent (rate limited). Try again later.
chat.selectHint: Pick a conversation or search for someone.

info.title: Privacy & information
info.e2e: Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. Server administrators can read messages through the database.
info.guest: Guest accounts are deleted 30 minutes after the last message in their conversation (or after creation if no message was sent).
info.retention: Conversations are deleted after 1 month of inactivity.
info.contact: Sharing contact information as a guest is voluntary. It is deleted together with the guest account.
